create_experiment_from_iterable: create a HiPlot Experiment from a list of dictionaries using Experiment.from_iterable
create_experiment_from_csv: create a HiPlot Experiment from a CSV file using Experiment.from_csv
create_experiment_from_dataframe: create a HiPlot Experiment from a pandas DataFrame using Experiment.from_dataframe
export_experiment_to_html: export a HiPlot Experiment to a standalone HTML file using Experiment.to_html
merge_experiments: merge multiple HiPlot Experiments into a single Experiment using Experiment.merge
